QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and otherwise forwards the result. The `Tokenizer::tokenize` doc says "empty on failure or empty input", so an empty vector cannot be told apart from an empty prompt.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and otherwise forwards the tokenizer's result, which is an empty vector on failure. So failure and "no tokenizer" give the same empty value, and the answer says an empty vector can't be told apart from an empty prompt.
